summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing the extract of minutes from its Ordinary and Extraordinary General Shareholders Meetings held on April 30, 2026. The meetings approved routine items: the annual report, management accounts, and financial statements for fiscal year 2025, as well as the allocation of net income of R$15.5 billion and dividend distribution of R$0.22 per share. No special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change occurred. This is a standard annual meeting filing with no extraordinary corporate action.
